simple.meaning: רַעֲלָה (raʻălâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a long veil (as fluttering ).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H7479. realah [ רְעָלָה ] noun [feminine] probably veil (compare Arabic above); — plural הָֽרְעָלוֺת Isa 3:19 , in list of finery. מַרְעֲלָה see above .
